2608.14385.title: DeaMoE: Efficient MoE Structure for Fast Small-Batch Decoding
2608.14385.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have been widely adopted in real-time interactive applications such as coding assistants, real-time audio-video interaction systems. To meet the extremely low response latency requirements of these scenarios, practitioners commonly employ small-batch decoding, under which MoE inference becomes memory-bound and is severely bottlenecked by expert weight loading. However, this bottleneck has received limited attention, and existing solutions such as post-training weight compression or fine-grained expert design during pre-training either degrade model accuracy or introduce additional computation and communication overhead. To tackle this issue, we propose DeaMoE, a decoding-efficient MoE architecture, in which the experts are grouped into several departments, and the experts belonging to the same department share most parameters since they come from the same professional field, and additionally each expert contains a few private parameters to reflect its uniqueness. Moreover, we design customized two-stage routing strategy for DeaMoE to avoid redundant loading, under which DeaMoE greatly improves the efficiency during LLM decoding. Compared with vanilla MoE, DeaMoE reduces per-step loaded weights by up to 50.9% and achieves up to 1.33 end-to-end TPOT speedup for the pre-trained 7B model on A40, and up to 2.00x and 1.97x peak speedup for DeepSeek-V3 on A40 and H100 in microbenchmarks.
2608.14385.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）模型已廣泛應用於即時互動應用，如編碼助手和即時音視頻互動系統。<lb/>為了滿足這些場景極低的響應延遲要求，從業者通常採用小批量解碼，在此情況下，MoE 推理變得受限於記憶體，並且在專家權重加載方面受到嚴重瓶頸。<lb/>然而，這一瓶頸受到的關注有限，現有的解決方案，如後訓練權重壓縮或在預訓練期間的細粒度專家設計，要麼降低模型準確性，要麼引入額外的計算和通信開銷。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 DeaMoE，一種解碼高效的 MoE 架構，其中專家被分組為幾個部門，來自同一專業領域的專家共享大部分參數，此外，每個專家還包含一些私有參數以反映其獨特性。<lb/>此外，我們為 DeaMoE 設計了定制的兩階段路由策略，以避免冗餘加載，在此情況下，DeaMoE 大幅提高了 LLM 解碼的效率。<lb/>與普通 MoE 相比，DeaMoE 每步加載的權重減少了多達 50.9%，並在 A40 上的預訓練 7B 模型上實現了高達 1.33 倍的端到端 TPOT 加速，在 A40 和 H100 上的 DeepSeek-V3 微基準測試中實現了高達 2.00 倍和 1.97 倍的峰值加速。
